test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Which statement is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: Around 650 families from the nearby villages were evacuated from the areas affected by the blowout.
The place where the blowout happened was close to the Dibru-Saikhowa National Park and the Maguri-Motapung wetlands.
One hoolock gibbon died soon after the leak of the oil from the blowout.
The blowout of an Oil India Limited (OIL) gas well occurred in Assam’s Tinsukia district.

solution:
The correct answer is "**One hoolock gibbon died soon after the leak of the oil from the blowout**".
